name: CreateImageCache

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone
parameters.help_zh: 可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. You can specify up to 10 vSwitch IDs, separated by commas (,). For example, `vsw-***,vsw-***`
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。支持指定多个交换机ID（单次最多10个），各交换机ID之间可以用半角逗号（,）进行分割，例如`vsw-***,vsw-***`
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the image cache
parameters.help_zh: 镜像缓存名称
parameters.name: image_cache_name

parameters.help_en: The EIP. To pull images from the Internet, make sure that the ECI instance can access the Internet. To enable Internet access, configure an EIP or a NAT Gateway
parameters.help_zh: 弹性公网IP。如果需要拉取公网镜像，需要确保ECI实例能够访问公网，您可以配置EIP或者NAT网关实现公网访问
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The size of the image cache. The default value is 20 GiB
parameters.help_zh: 镜像缓存的大小。默认为20 GiB
parameters.name: image_cache_size

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of the image cache. The image cache is cleared after the retention period expires. By default, the image cache never expires.

An image cache that fails to be created is retained for only one day
parameters.help_zh:
镜像缓存保留时间，过期将会被清理，默认永不过期。

创建失败的镜像缓存仅保留一天
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable image cache reuse. If you enable this feature, new image caches can reuse the image layers of existing image caches. This speeds up the creation of image caches. Valid values:

true

false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启镜像缓存复用。开启后，新创建的镜像缓存可以复用已有镜像缓存的镜像层，加快镜像缓存的制作速度。取值范围：

true：开启

false：不开启

默认为false
parameters.name: auto_match_image_cache

fields.help_en: The password for the image repository
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The address of the image repository. Do not include the `http://` or `https://` prefix
fields.help_zh: 不带 `http://` 或  `https://` 前缀的镜像仓库地址
fields.name: server

fields.help_en: The username for the image repository
fields.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The credentials of the image repository
parameters.help_zh: 镜像仓库信息
parameters.name: image_registry_credential

parameters.help_en: The container images used to create the image cache
parameters.help_zh: 用于制作镜像缓存的容器镜像
parameters.name: image

fields.help_en: The key of the image cache tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the image cache tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the image cache. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 镜像缓存标签信息，最多20个
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the instant image cache feature. If you enable this feature, the creation of the image cache is accelerated. Valid values:

true

false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启极速镜像缓存功能，开启后，可以加速镜像缓存创建。取值范围：

true：开启

false：不开启

默认为false
parameters.name: flash

fields.help_en: The domain names of the ACR Enterprise instance. By default, all domain names of the instance are specified. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: ACR企业版实例的域名。默认为相应实例的所有域名。支持指定个别域名，多个以半角逗号分隔
fields.name: domain

fields.help_en: The name of the ACR Enterprise instance
fields.name: instance_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the ACR Enterprise instance
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region where the ACR Enterprise instance resides
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role that belongs to the account of the resource, such as an ECI instance
fields.help_zh: ECI实例等资源归属账号下的RAM角色的ARN
fields.name: arn_service

fields.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role that belongs to the account of the ACR instance
fields.help_zh: ACR实例归属账号下的RAM角色的ARN
fields.name: arn_user

parameters.help_en: The information about the ACR instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194250.html
parameters.help_zh: ACR实例信息。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194250.html
parameters.name: acr_registry_info

parameters.help_en: The annotations. This parameter is not for external use
parameters.help_zh: 注解。该参数暂不对外使用
parameters.name: annotations

parameters.help_en: The address of a self-managed image repository. When you create an image cache using an image from a self-managed image repository that uses the HTTP protocol, set this parameter to allow ECI to pull the image over HTTP. This prevents image pull failures caused by protocol mismatch
parameters.help_zh: 自建镜像仓库地址。使用HTTP协议的自建镜像仓库中的镜像创建镜像缓存时，需配置该参数，使得ECI使用HTTP协议拉取镜像，避免因协议不同而导致镜像拉取失败
parameters.name: plain_http_registry

parameters.help_en:
The address of a self-managed image repository.

When you create an image cache using an image from a self-managed image repository that uses a self-signed certificate, set this parameter to skip certificate verification. This prevents image pull failures caused by certificate verification failures
parameters.help_zh:
自建镜像仓库地址。

使用自签发证书的自建镜像仓库中的镜像创建镜像缓存时，需配置该参数来跳过证书认证，避免因证书认证失败而导致镜像拉取失败
parameters.name: insecure_registry

parameters.help_en:
The number of standard snapshot replicas. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in a batch, create multiple snapshot replicas. Add one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

If the instant image cache feature is disabled (Flash is set to false), only standard snapshots are created during the image cache creation process
parameters.help_zh:
标准快照副本数。默认情况下，一个镜像缓存对应一个快照。如果该镜像缓存将用于批量创建多个ECI实例，建议您配置该参数实现快照多副本。推荐每1000个ECI实例增加一个快照副本。

未开启极速镜像缓存功能（Flash取值为false）时，创镜像缓存的过程中仅生成标准快照
parameters.name: standard_copy_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of local snapshot replicas. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in a batch, create multiple snapshot replicas. Add one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

If the instant image cache feature is enabled (Flash is set to true), local snapshots are first created during the image cache creation process. After the local snapshots are created, standard snapshots are created. After the standard snapshots are created, the local snapshots are automatically deleted
parameters.help_zh:
本地快照副本数。默认情况下，一个镜像缓存对应一个快照。如果该镜像缓存将用于批量创建多个ECI实例，建议您配置该参数实现快照多副本。推荐每1000个ECI实例增加一个快照副本。

开启极速镜像缓存功能（Flash取值为true）时，创建镜像缓存的过程中将先创建本地快照，在本地快照创建完成后开始创建标准快照，待标准快照创建完成后会自动删除本地快照
parameters.name: flash_copy_count

parameters.help_en:
The eviction policy of the image cache. The default value is empty, which indicates that the image cache is always retained.

You can set this parameter to LRU, which indicates that the image cache can be automatically deleted. When the number of image caches reaches the quota limit, the system automatically deletes the image caches that are least recently used and have EliminationStrategy set to LRU
parameters.help_zh:
镜像缓存的淘汰策略。默认为空，表示一直保留。

支持配置为LRU，表示可以被自动删除。当镜像缓存数量达到配额限制时，系统将自动删除最不常用的EliminationStrategy为LRU的镜像缓存
parameters.name: elimination_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the container image. Valid values:

Linux (default)

Windows

Windows is in invitational preview. To use this feature, submit a ticket
parameters.help_zh:
容器镜像的操作系统。取值范围：

Linux（默认值）
Windows

Windows正在邀测中，如需使用，请提交工单申请
parameters.name: os_type
